title: The Nvidia Files - Part 1: Who Is Alice Huang?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: October 29th, 2026. Jensen Huang is on the phone with Bloomberg.
lines.shot_hint: night office, close-up of a glowing phone, place tag Santa Clara / date

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That morning, the New York Times reported something explosive about a woman close to him.
lines.shot_hint: newspaper spins in, headline blurred, camera push-in

lines.speaker: HUANG
lines.text: It was all completely normal and not unusual.
lines.shot_hint: CEO close-up, calm smirk; real on-record quote (Bloomberg, Oct 29)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Ten days later, he writes to his own employees.
lines.shot_hint: envelope / email on a desk, tear-off calendar flips 10 days

lines.speaker: HUANG
lines.text: I was unfaithful to my wife.
lines.shot_hint: typed text card, gold on navy; real quote from his Nov 8 note

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Four days after that, he is out. The co-founder of the first company ever worth four trillion dollars.
lines.shot_hint: board-room door closes; $4 TRILLION counter ticks

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At the center stands a woman U.S. officials reportedly believe worked for China.
lines.shot_hint: silhouette behind frosted glass, name tag withheld

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: She has not been charged. China calls the claim groundless.
lines.shot_hint: stamp UNPROVEN in navy, no orange

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And how this reaches your retirement account is closer than you think.
lines.shot_hint: quick cut: a 401(k) statement, a gold coin

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So who is she? And how did she end up beside the most powerful man in AI?
lines.shot_hint: text card, key words gold

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Rewind to 2023, in Singapore.
lines.shot_hint: night skyline set, place tag Singapore 2023, whip-pan in

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A little-known company called Megaspeed has just been reborn.
lines.shot_hint: sign above a door being swapped, new name MEGASPEED

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Before that, it was the Singapore arm of a Chinese video game company.
lines.shot_hint: old arcade sign comes down, new sign goes up

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Within days of its sale to a Singapore company, reports say, it became an official Nvidia cloud partner.
lines.shot_hint: certificate slides onto a desk, NVIDIA CLOUD PARTNER (chip logo only, no green)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Now it wanted to rent out computing power. The kind built on Nvidia chips.
lines.shot_hint: server racks, glowing chips, gold light

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Everyone wants those chips. Not everyone is allowed to have them.
lines.shot_hint: chip on a velvet display, a hand reaches, a red rope

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Jensen Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993. For thirty-three years, he was its only CEO.
lines.shot_hint: 1993 garage-diner set, young-ish Jensen character, calendar flips to 2026

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Its boss was Alice Huang. A Chinese national, according to U.S. reports. A Hong Kong resident, according to Singapore.
lines.shot_hint: alice character first appears; lower third: Alice Huang, then-CEO Megaspeed
lines.hint: Alice character first appears; lower third: Alice Huang, then-CEO Megaspeed (Singapore: Hong Kong resident)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: No relation to Jensen Huang. Same last name. That is all.
lines.shot_hint: two name tags side by side, an equals sign crossed out

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In 2023, Megaspeed's assets were about thirty-three million dollars.
lines.shot_hint: counter over office set

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A year later, almost three billion.
lines.shot_hint: counter races up, small camera shake

lines.speaker: ANALYST
lines.text: Thirty-three million to three billion? In one year?
lines.shot_hint: analyst close-up, wide eyes (generic role, dramatised)

lines.speaker: INVESTOR
lines.text: Maybe it was a very good year.
lines.shot_hint: investor shrugs, coffee cup (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: ANALYST
lines.text: Maybe.
lines.shot_hint: analyst raises one brow, dry sting (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One Tufts professor said the company appeared out of nowhere.
lines.shot_hint: professor tag, quote on sticky note (his opinion)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then, on December seventh, 2023, a photo. Jensen and Alice Huang, at a Singapore restaurant.
lines.shot_hint: restaurant night set, polaroid slides in, labelled REPORTED

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By September 2024, a U.S. official was walking through a data center in Malaysia.
lines.shot_hint: Malaysia place tag, inspector walks a long aisle

lines.speaker: INSPECTOR
lines.text: Why are these Nvidia servers still sitting in their boxes?
lines.shot_hint: close-up, flashlight on sealed crates (generic role, dramatised from NYT report)

lines.speaker: COLLEAGUE
lines.text: Should I take photos?
lines.shot_hint: second inspector, clipboard (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: INSPECTOR
lines.text: Of every box.
lines.shot_hint: flashlight sweeps the crates (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Remember those boxes. Soon, Washington will start asking about them.
lines.shot_hint: crate stencil glows gold, hard cut to black

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So what was Washington worried about? Chips.
lines.shot_hint: map: United States to China, dotted route

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Since October 2022, the most advanced Nvidia AI chips are banned from China.
lines.shot_hint: framed map, BANNED stamp (navy), arrow stopped at the border

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The Justice Department says smugglers keep trying. Hundreds of millions of dollars' worth, over several years.
lines.shot_hint: cash/coin counter, handcuffs sting

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Singapore noticed Megaspeed too. In February 2025, its police and customs opened an investigation.
lines.shot_hint: police badge, case file slams on desk

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The suspicion: false declarations about server purchases. Singapore says it acted on its own. No foreign request.
lines.shot_hint: document close-up, key line highlighted, stamp: OFFICIAL FINDING

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then came June twenty-fourth, 2025.
lines.shot_hint: tear-off calendar to JUNE 24

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: U.S. export officials inspect a Megaspeed site. Alice Huang is there.
lines.shot_hint: site visit, clipboard, Alice in frame, camera pushes in

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That same day, Singapore police interview her. And impound her passport.
lines.shot_hint: passport slides across a desk, hand slam

lines.speaker: OFFICER
lines.text: Please hand over your passport. You are not leaving yet.
lines.shot_hint: police officer close-up (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The same month, Nvidia says it cut Megaspeed off. No new orders. No shipments.
lines.shot_hint: Nvidia logo-free green-free chip, door slams, gold padlock

lines.speaker: CLERK
lines.text: New order from Megaspeed.
lines.shot_hint: order desk, phone to ear (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: MANAGER
lines.text: Not anymore.
lines.shot_hint: manager stamps the order cancelled, navy stamp (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It has not said why.
lines.shot_hint: empty chair, blinking cursor

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two months later, on August thirtieth, Alice Huang leaves Megaspeed. That is the company's account.
lines.shot_hint: calendar AUG 30 circled in gold

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Hold that date.
lines.shot_hint: date stays on screen, music drops

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A short seller called Culper Research quoted an employee who said she was still the boss.
lines.shot_hint: report page, quote highlighted, label: CLAIM, NOT PROVEN

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The records and the claims point in different directions.
lines.shot_hint: two arrows diverge on a framed board

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In October 2025, the New York Times asked it bluntly. Is China buying banned Nvidia chips? It said Megaspeed was poised to buy two billion dollars of Nvidia technology within a year.
lines.shot_hint: newspaper spins in, $2 BILLION counter ticks, framed style

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But the biggest question was never about chips. It was about who she was talking to.
lines.shot_hint: phone rings, close-up of a glowing screen

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So how do banned chips allegedly reach China? Three ways.
lines.shot_hint: whiteboard, three numbered doors

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One. Smuggling. Prosecutors in a separate case say workers swapped labels with a hair dryer.
lines.shot_hint: hands, hair dryer peeling a sticker, fake brand on the box

lines.speaker: WORKER
lines.text: This sticker will not budge.
lines.shot_hint: alleged separate case, depicted generically (dramatised)

lines.speaker: COLLEAGUE
lines.text: Hit it with the hair dryer.
lines.shot_hint: hair dryer peels the sticker (alleged separate case, dramatised)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two. Middlemen. A company in Southeast Asia buys the servers and quietly passes them on.
lines.shot_hint: boxes pass along a conveyor, a map pin hops countries

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Three. Renting. The chips never leave Asia. A buyer in China just logs in from afar.
lines.shot_hint: laptop in Beijing, dotted line to a server room, ding

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In May 2025, the Commerce Department warned U.S. firms to watch for partners offering cloud access to China.
lines.shot_hint: warning memo slides in, key line highlighted gold

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Think of a pizza oven banned in one town. Nobody can sell you the oven. But anyone can sell you pizza.
lines.shot_hint: analogy scene: oven, delivery scooter, framed stage

lines.speaker: CUSTOMER
lines.text: One pizza oven, please.
lines.shot_hint: analogy scene, shop counter (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: SELLER
lines.text: Sorry. Ovens are banned in this town.
lines.shot_hint: seller points at a BANNED sign (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: CUSTOMER
lines.text: Then I'll take a pizza.
lines.shot_hint: customer perks up (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: SELLER
lines.text: Pizza is fine.
lines.shot_hint: seller slides a pizza box across, sting (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: No one has proven Megaspeed did any of this. The company flatly denies it.
lines.shot_hint: text card: No one has proven Megaspeed did this.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Last December it said there was no evidence of illicit chip transfers.
lines.shot_hint: company statement paper, DENIED stamp in navy

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But U.S. intelligence wasn't only watching the chips. It was listening.
lines.shot_hint: headphones, waveform, music cuts out

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Here is what almost nobody outside Washington knew.
lines.shot_hint: black background, single gold line

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: According to the New York Times, U.S. intelligence was watching Alice Huang.
lines.shot_hint: surveillance room, screens of waveforms (navy, gold, no green)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And the American on the other end, reportedly, was the CEO of Nvidia.
lines.shot_hint: TEXT CARD: music cuts to silence, low boom (TWIST beat)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: U.S. rules hide Americans' names in surveillance. Officials asked to reveal this one.
lines.shot_hint: redacted bars slide off a document, name hidden

lines.speaker: ANALYST
lines.text: The American's name is masked.
lines.shot_hint: surveillance room, redacted bars (generic, dramatised from reported unmasking)

lines.speaker: SUPERVISOR
lines.text: Then ask them to unmask it.
lines.shot_hint: supervisor leans in, screens glow (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The name came back. Jensen Huang.
lines.shot_hint: stamp slam REVEALED on redacted page, camera shake

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: October twenty-ninth. The Times goes public.
lines.shot_hint: newspaper spins in, framed style

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: People briefed on the surveillance said officials had concluded that Alice Huang was a Chinese intelligence asset.
lines.shot_hint: document close-up, key line gold, label: REPORTED

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It also said Huang never got a defensive briefing. A warning agencies sometimes give.
lines.shot_hint: envelope marked WARNING never opened, sits on a desk

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nvidia's answer came fast. Megaspeed was one of many regional customers, it said.
lines.shot_hint: press-room podium, two microphones

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Huang said the U.S. government had never told him of its suspicions.
lines.shot_hint: CEO close-up, hands spread, small sweat drop

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: China's foreign ministry called the spy claim groundless speculation.
lines.shot_hint: flag-coloured lectern (real flag colours only), denial stamp

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Attorney General Todd Blanche later said the Justice Department had reached no conclusion on whether she was a spy.
lines.shot_hint: DOJ podium, blank verdict card

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Singapore added a twist. Its Home Affairs ministry said she was never investigated for espionage.
lines.shot_hint: official statement page, key words highlighted

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: They found too little evidence to charge her. But they warned her, and banned her from returning, for giving inaccurate information about her role.
lines.shot_hint: stern warning letter, ENTRY BANNED stamp (navy)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So where does that leave us? A spy? Reported. Not proven.
lines.shot_hint: text card, gold on UNPROVEN

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: November fifth. Nvidia's top lawyer reportedly goes to Huang's home. And asks if the affair reports are true.
lines.shot_hint: doorstep at night, lit window, a briefcase

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He reportedly said they were.
lines.shot_hint: hold on a closed door

lines.speaker: LAWYER
lines.text: Jensen, are the reports true?
lines.shot_hint: doorstep at night (generic role; paraphrase of a reported exchange, dramatised)

lines.speaker: HUANG
lines.text: They are.
lines.shot_hint: close-up, heavy pause (paraphrase of a reported reply, dramatised; verify sourcing)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The same week, three House chairs asked him for a closed-door briefing.
lines.shot_hint: three chairs at a long table, an empty seat in the middle

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: November eighth. He tells his colleagues. And he does not name her.
lines.shot_hint: typed note, the line where a name should be is empty

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The board opens an independent investigation. It says it has no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised.
lines.shot_hint: board table, a folder slides to the center, gavel-free

lines.speaker: DIRECTOR
lines.text: We need outside lawyers.
lines.shot_hint: board table (generic, dramatised; Nvidia hired Wachtell Lipton on Nov 10)

lines.speaker: SECOND DIRECTOR
lines.text: Call them tonight.
lines.shot_hint: board table, phone slides across (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The next day, Nvidia stock drops more than five percent.
lines.shot_hint: orange down arrow counter, minus sign

lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: Nvidia is down five percent.
lines.shot_hint: trading floor, orange numbers (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: SECOND TRADER
lines.text: On a Monday?
lines.shot_hint: trader drops his coffee, sting (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By November eleventh, it is down about eleven percent in five days.
lines.shot_hint: line chart crashes, orange arrow

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Remember August thirtieth? On November fifteenth, Megaspeed repeated it. She left more than a year ago, it says. And it is investigating itself.
lines.shot_hint: callback to calendar AUG 30, company statement page

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On November twelfth, Nvidia announces that Huang has resigned. Effective immediately.
lines.shot_hint: 8-K page slides in, RESIGNED stamp in navy

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But one question will not go away. Officials reportedly knew about her for months. So why, the Times said, was he never warned?
lines.shot_hint: text card, cliffhanger, music holds an unresolved chord

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Here is where this reaches your money.
lines.shot_hint: day/lesson set, whiteboard

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: You probably own Nvidia. Even if you have never bought a share.
lines.shot_hint: day/living: laptop with a 401(k) statement

lines.speaker: SAVER
lines.text: But I never bought Nvidia.
lines.shot_hint: day/living: saver character, laptop open, puzzled (generic role, dramatised)

lines.speaker: ANALYST
lines.text: Check your index fund.
lines.shot_hint: day/living: analyst on a video call (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: SAVER
lines.text: I own an index fund?
lines.shot_hint: saver squints at a statement (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: ANALYST
lines.text: Probably. Open it.
lines.shot_hint: sting; cut to pie chart (generic, dramatised)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: If you hold an S&P 500 index fund, about six percent of it is Nvidia.
lines.shot_hint: pie chart grows, Nvidia slice in gold

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: This spring it was closer to eight and a half. In 2022, it was about one.
lines.shot_hint: line chart rises steeply, gold line, J.P. Morgan label

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That is roughly six hundred dollars of every ten thousand you invest.
lines.shot_hint: counter next to a stack of ten $1,000 bundles, one pulled out

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: When Nvidia dropped about eleven percent, the rest of the index cushioned it. This time.
lines.shot_hint: bar chart: Nvidia down, S&P bar up (navy up arrow, orange down arrow)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A decade ago, the ten biggest companies were under a fifth of the S&P 500. Today, seven are about a third.
lines.shot_hint: bar chart grows

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That is called concentration risk. And one person can move it.
lines.shot_hint: teeter-totter tips (scales), a single figure on one side

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Here are five things worth checking.
lines.shot_hint: RED FLAGS board appears, 5 slots

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One. How much of your fund is just a few companies?
lines.shot_hint: board flag 1 pops, soft pop

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two. Does one founder hold the whole company together?
lines.shot_hint: board flag 2 pops

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Three. Does one customer or partner drive big growth?
lines.shot_hint: board flag 3 pops

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Four. Can the biggest customers be checked? Or are they a mystery?
lines.shot_hint: board flag 4 pops

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Five. Do the board and the rules move before the headlines do?
lines.shot_hint: board flag 5 pops

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: This is education, not financial advice. Just a habit: open your fund, and look inside the box.
lines.shot_hint: sticky note slammed: LOOK INSIDE THE BOX

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Back on that October call, Huang called it all normal.
lines.shot_hint: return to the opening phone shot, now with the word NORMAL in gold

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: What we can prove so far fits on one hand. A company. A woman. A CEO. A letter. A resignation.
lines.shot_hint: five props appear one by one on a desk

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Everything else is a question.
lines.shot_hint: props fade, one stays: the unopened envelope

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Who knew about her? And when?
lines.shot_hint: final black card held, soft sting; music resolves on one chord

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In part two, we follow the briefings.
lines.shot_hint: next-video teaser, end screen section follows
